channel.title: SUSE — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by SUSE (suse).

item.title: CVE-2026-109091 · 7.8 HIGH — X.Org Server EDID DS_RANGES Out-Of-Bounds Write
item.description: A buffer overflow in handling EDID Display-Range descriptors in X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X Server before 21.1.26 could be used by malicious monitors to crash the x server or execute cote.

item.title: CVE-2026-109092 · 7.8 HIGH — X.Org Server XvShmPutImage Shared-Memory Bounds Overflow
item.description: Incorrectly handled negative sizes when processing ProcXvShmPutImage requests in the X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X Server before 21.1.26 could be used by local authenticated X clients to crash the X server or execute code.

item.title: CVE-2026-109093 · 8.5 HIGH — X.Org Server XTestFakeInput Valuator Stack Out-Of-Bounds Write
item.description: A stack buffer overflow in ProcXTestFakeInput DeviceValuator handling in X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X server before 21.1.26 could be used by authenticated clients to crash or execute code in the X server.

item.title: CVE-2026-109094 · 8.5 HIGH — X.Org Server XRes QueryResourceBytes Swap Path Size Overflow
item.description: A integer overflow that can lead to a buffer overrread in the XRes QueryResourceBytes Swap Path in the X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X Server before 21.1.26 on 32bit systems could be used by authenticated clients to crash the X server.

item.title: CVE-2026-109095 · 6.9 MEDIUM — X.Org Server glamor Xv Image Size Integer Overflow
item.description: A integer overflow in glamor Xv Image Size handling in X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X server before 21.1.26 could be used by authenticated clients to crash the X server or leak out data.

item.title: CVE-2026-109096 · 5.5 MEDIUM — X.Org Server XvPutImage Negative Image Size Length Bypass
item.description: Incorrect handling of negative returns from ddQueryImageAttributes() when processing XvPutImage requests in X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X Server before 21.1.26 could be used by authenticated X clients to crash the X server.

item.title: CVE-2026-109903 · 7.8 HIGH — X.Org Server XvQueryImageAttributes Negative Size Reply
item.description: A buffer overread caused by casting a negative integer to CARD32 in XvQueryImageAttributes in X.Org X Server before 21.1.26 and xwayland before 24.1.15 could be used to causes crashes by authenticated X clients.

item.title: CVE-2026-109904 · 6.9 MEDIUM — X.Org Server XRes QueryClientIds Request Size Overflow
item.description: A buffer overread caused by an integer-overflow in Proc/SProcXResQueryClientIds in X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X Server before 21.1.26 could be used by attackers on authenticated X clients to crash the server or leak out information.

item.title: CVE-2026-104619 · 7.8 HIGH — PackageKit ZYpp rollback vulnerability
item.description: Untrusted users could roll back security updates when using the PackageKit Zypp Backend before 1.4.1, allowing privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-104620 · 8.5 HIGH — PackageKit/ZYpp local privilege escalation using InstallFiles(SIMULATE)
item.description: A path traversal attack in simulation of actions in the Zypp backend of PackageKit before 1.4.1 could be used by local attackers to gain root privileges.

item.description: A double free in XKB SetGeometryin X.Org X Server before 21.1.25 and X Wayland before 24.1.14 could be used by attached clients to cause a crash or potentially code in the x server context.

item.title: CVE-2026-109090 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — libXi XGetDeviceControl DEVICE_ENABLE Heap Buffer Overflow
item.description: A malicious X server could cause a heap overflow by injecting a large DEVICE_ENABLE reply when processed by libXi before 1.8.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-109088 · 6.5 MEDIUM 🌩️ — libXtst RECORD EnableContext Reply Endless Loop
item.description: A malicious X server could send malformed RECORD EnableContext reolies that can cause a X client using the parse_reply_call_callback function in libXtst before 1.2.6 to enter a endless loop.

item.title: CVE-2026-109089 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — libXi XGetDeviceControl Control Type Mismatch Heap Buffer Overflow
item.description: A buffer overflow when handling DEVICE_RESOLUTION in libXi before 1.8.4 could overflow a heap, triggered by a malicious X server.

item.title: CVE-2026-104618 · 6.9 MEDIUM — sdbootutil: world-readable debug log
item.description: On request the `sdbootutil` script creates a world-readable debug log in /var/log/sdbootutil.log. The log file is created world-readable, however, which means that arbitrary low-privileged users in the system will be able to extract secrets from it.

item.title: CVE-2026-104617 · 5.9 MEDIUM — sdbootutil: qrencode invocation leaks PIN/recovery key in /proc/<pid>/cmdline
item.description: There are two invocations of `qrencode` to display a QR code for scanning. These invocations leak the private data $pin / $key via /proc accessible for arbitrary low-privileged users in the system.
